abilities.name: Field Triage
abilities.text: Once per round, after you resolve a sanctuary, clinic, or stabilization action, heal 1 Wound from yourself or an operative in your sector.

abilities.name: Scar Ledger
abilities.text: When a Scar would block your Gear or action, reveal it and reduce its penalty by 1 for this roll only.

abilities.name: Siege Discipline
abilities.text: At the start of your turn, if you have at least 1 Wound, record a private triage entry.

abilities.name: Amber Draught
abilities.text: Once per round, after you pass a Grit test, heal 1 Wound. Weakness: Field Triage cannot be used during battle.
